name: Achiri HTTP bridge — Telegram bot routes to ACHIRI_BASE_URL (production wiring)
goal: Decouple Telegram bot from Achiri in-process module. Replace direct AchiriConversationHandler import in commands.ts with HTTP fetch to ACHIRI_BASE_URL env var (default: http://localhost:3420). Telegram bot works in dev (localhost) or production (Hetzner public URL) by setting env. Handle limit_exceeded response with upgrade_url inline message.
rationale: Sprint 129 created the deploy package. Sprint 130 wires the Telegram bot to the deployed Achiri API. Without this, the bot still imports Achiri in-process — which works locally but won't work when Telegram bot runs on Mac Mini and Achiri runs on Hetzner. ACHIRI_BASE_URL env makes routing configurable without code changes.
swarm: NOT USED — single-file surgical edit to commands.ts + new validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — replace AchiriConversationHandler import with HTTP fetch
tasks.description: Remove: import { AchiriConversationHandler } from '../achiri/index'. Remove: achiriHandlers Map and getAchiriHandler(). Replace handleAchiri() body: fetch(ACHIRI_BASE_URL + '/chat', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ userId: String(chatId), tier: 'free', message }) }). Parse JSON response. If error==='limit_exceeded' → send upgrade message with upgrade_url if present. If normal reply → sendMessage(chatId, reply). ACHIRI_BASE_URL defaults to http://localhost:3420.
